ResearchProjectDef.label: video surveillance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop closed-circuit video systems for monitoring the colony through surveillance stations, wall-mounted cameras, and wired video networks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: camera tower
ResearchProjectDef.description: Adapt wall-mounted surveillance technology into elevated, all-direction camera towers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: loudspeakers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct colony-wide loudspeakers and alarm triggers for warning the colony of danger.

ResearchProjectDef.label: walkie talkies
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop portable short-range radios that allow colonists to report threats across the colony.

ResearchProjectDef.label: remote surveillance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture technology capable of transmitting camera feeds to portable remote devices.

ResearchProjectDef.label: watchtower
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop elevated observation platforms that allow a sentry to monitor a wide area around the colony.
